title: For Lowe's Walton, Kentucky store manager it's a homecoming 28 years in the making
summary: For Lowe's Walton, Kentucky store manager it's a homecoming 28 years in the making
body_markdown:
For Store Manager Travis Caldwell, opening Lowe's newest store in Kentucky isn't just another milestone in a


28 year


career. It's a homecoming.


The Northern Kentucky native started out at Lowe's as a part-time loader while at college and never left. Now nearly 30


years on


he's in charge of the new Lowe's in Walton, just miles from where he grew up.


"I've lived in this area my entire life and I'm absolutely thrilled to be able to continue my Lowe's career here in Walton," Travis said. "I'm very proud to be a part of such a well-respected area in our Commonwealth of Kentucky."


The new Walton's store is Lowe's first new store in Kentucky in 17 years and brings Lowe's a lot closer to the customers in a very


fast growing


part of Northern Kentucky.


"This store was a welcome addition because of the number of customers south of us who needed


a Lowe's


closer to where they lived and worked," Travis explained. "The area is still growing and will continue to grow for years to come."
